description: One menu primitive (owned-menu + menu-row with real submenus, sections, checkmarks, destructive tone, keyboard nav, desktop popover to phone sheet from one definition) and one picker primitive family (select/multi-select with search and create, date with time and presets, relation, colour, icon) for every dropdown, menu, popover and picker in src/views, with a per-surface migration table and the Anytype menu grammar each migration takes or declines
